name: Ferienwohnung Tragseil
beschreibung: The Ferienwohnung Tragseil is located in the quiet municipality of Thiersee in Tiroler Unterland, not far from the German border. The surroundings are rural and offer an unobstructed view of the surrounding mountains of the Kaisergebirges. The accommodation is a self-contained holiday apartment with a fully equipped kitchen and separate sleeping areas. Guests can arrange their stay flexibly here and explore nature in the immediate surroundings. In summer, the surrounding hiking and cycling trails are ideal for extended tours, while the Thiersee invites swimming and stand-up paddling. In winter, groomed cross-country ski trails and the nearby Zahmer Kaiser ski area are available. An excursion to the fortress town of Kufstein is easily reachable both by car and by public transport.
